judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements the core usage accumulation logic, adds solid unit and acceptance tests, and updates the spec and CHANGELOG as requested. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the hook signature/type to make the answer unambiguous (even though the candidate checked this off in its own DoD, it never actually modified `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and left the local variable named `lastUsage`). Additionally, the candidate placed `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and created a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree), whereas the reference kept the helper and tests inside `chatOrchestrator.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
